picks.file: Arazzi Battaglia di Pavia - Veduta di Pavia.png
picks.what: The city during the 1525 battle, detail of the Battle of Pavia tapestries (Capodimonte, Naples)
picks.who: Bernard van Orley, woven by Willem Dermoyen
picks.why: only early view; walled city of towers behind the siege lines; low resolution (421 px high)

picks.file: Veduta generale di Pavia, presa dalla via dei Mille, già Borgo Ticino (xilografia).jpg
picks.what: General view from the Borgo Ticino, wood engraving in Le Cento Città d’Italia
picks.why: wide general view with the cathedral dome over the rooftops

gaps: P0, P3, P6: no candidates. P2: nothing. P1 has only the tapestry: the 1617 bird’s-eye plan (#2) is photographed as an open two-page spread with the gutter through the city. P5: Acerbi’s color view from the Ticino (#9) is dated only ‘before 1920’.
notes: The tapestry detail is marked as an event (the 1525 battle and siege). The Brogi photos and the photochrom (#3–#7) all show the Certosa di Pavia, a monastery about 8 km north of the city, so skipped. #9 (Acerbi) would be an excellent view if a firm date turns up.
